title: 第8章 收买
novel_title: 我有一个黑暗密武世界
content_zh:
下课铃响。

    训练室里的气氛还没散去，不少人三三两两聚在一起，讨论着省赛的事。

    “走走走，吃饭去！”

    吴志超一把搂住陈峰的肩膀，

    “今天食堂一楼有红烧灵鸡腿，我请你，咱哥俩好好聊聊，你小子到底在外面跟谁学的？进步这么猛？”

    林远也凑了过来：“对啊峰哥，你那师傅还收不收徒？给兄弟引荐引荐呗。”

    陈峰刚要开口，一道清冷的女声从侧面传来。

    “陈峰，等一下。”

    三人同时转头。

    班长冯曦站在两步开外，一头高马尾，身形笔挺修长，整个人显得颇为干净利落。

    吴志超和林远对视了一眼。

    班长找陈峰？

    “你们先等等，我跟他说两句。”

    冯曦朝吴志超他们点了点头，语气平淡。

    吴志超和林远对视一眼，识趣的往后退了半步。

    “冯班长，什么事？”陈峰问。

    “耽误你几分钟。”冯曦偏了偏头，示意旁边没人的角落，“单独说。”

    陈峰跟着走了过去。

    训练室里的人已经走差不多了，只剩几个收拾东西的同学。

    冯曦背靠窗台，开口道：

    “我想请你这半个月别再旷课了。”

    陈峰微微挑眉：“为什么？”

    冯曦平静开口：

    “下个月有一个校内优秀班干部的评选。”

    “评选标准里，班级出勤率占百分之十五的权重，你连续旷课，直接把三班的出勤率拉到了年级倒数。”

    她顿了顿。

    “我需要这个优秀班干部。”

    陈峰听明白了，冯曦目标是保研，这在班里不是秘密。

    她从入学第一天起就在卷绩点、卷学分、卷综测排名，每一项加分项都不放过。

    优秀班干部能加两个学分，这对她来说确实很重要，而陈峰持续旷课等于在拖她后腿。

    “我知道这个要求对你来说有些突然。”

    冯曦神色平静，倒是并没有什么居高临下的味道：“所以我愿意给你补偿。”

    “两万块。”

    “这段时间你正常来上课，我给你转两万块。”

    陈峰愣了一下，两万？

    这个数字确实出乎他的意料。

    冯曦家里条件好他是知道的，但能够为了一个班干部评选直接掏两万块钱，确实令他有些始料未及。

    换成一个月前的他，这两万块他可能想都不想就答应了。

    但现在……

    陈峰在心里盘算了一下。

    半个月后就是省赛名额的校内选拔，他现在体质12.0，距离淬体中期的门槛还差整整1点。

    单单在学校里上课和训练肯定是来不及的。

    他唯一的办法就是在这半个月里反复进入大墟通过采集灵材，把体质提到13。

    如果老老实实在学校待半个月，白天上课晚上训练，按部就班，那省赛名额就跟他没关系了。

    而省赛前十的奖金最高十万，还有三级助理研究生身份和保研机会，

    这些东西加在一起远不是两万块能比的。

    “不好意思，班长。”

    陈峰摇了摇头，

    “这个忙我帮不了。”

    冯曦的表情没什么变化，但微微眯了一下眼。

    “为什么？”

    陈峰神色平静，开口道：“我打算参加半个月后的省赛名额选拔，这段时间，我要专心修行。”

    冯曦听完这话，愣了足足两秒，嘴角动了动，似乎想说什么又咽了回去。
content_en:
The bell rings.

    The atmosphere in the training room has not dissipated, and many people gathered together in twos and threes to discuss the provincial competition.

    "Let's go and eat!"

    Wu Zhichao put his arm around Chen Feng's shoulders.

    "Today there are braised chicken drumsticks on the first floor of the cafeteria. Let me ask you and us to have a good chat. Who did you learn from outside? Are you making such great progress?"

    Lin Yuan also came over: "That's right, Brother Feng, does your master still accept apprentices? Let's introduce him to my brothers."

    Just as Chen Feng was about to speak, a cold female voice came from the side.

    "Chen Feng, wait a moment."

    The three of them turned their heads at the same time.

    Squad leader Feng Xi stood two steps away. He had a high ponytail and a straight and slender figure. He looked quite neat and tidy.

    Wu Zhichao and Lin Yuan looked at each other.

    The monitor is looking for Chen Feng?

    "You guys wait a minute, I'll have a word with him."

    Feng Xi nodded towards Wu Zhichao and the others with a calm tone.

    Wu Zhichao and Lin Yuan looked at each other and took half a step back knowingly.

    "Monitor Feng, what's going on?" Chen Feng asked.

    "I'll give you a few minutes." Feng Xi tilted his head and gestured to a corner where no one was around, "Let's talk alone."

    Chen Feng followed and walked over.

    Most of the people in the training room have left, and only a few classmates are left packing their things.

    Feng Xi leaned against the window sill and said:

    "I would like to ask you not to miss school for the next half month."

    Chen Feng raised his eyebrows slightly: "Why?"

    Feng Xi said calmly:

    "Next month there will be a selection of outstanding class leaders in the school."

    "In the selection criteria, class attendance accounts for 15% of the weight. Your continuous absence from class has directly brought the attendance rate of Class 3 to the bottom of the grade."

    She paused.

    "I need this outstanding class leader."

    Chen Feng understood that Feng Xi's goal was to obtain a graduate degree, which was no secret in the class.

    From the first day she enrolled, she was ranked in grade points, credits, and comprehensive tests, and she did not miss out on every bonus item.

    Outstanding class cadres can get two additional credits, which is really important to her, and Chen Feng's continued absence from class is equivalent to holding her back.

    "I know this request is a bit sudden for you."

    Feng Xi's expression was calm, but there was nothing condescending about it: "So I am willing to compensate you."

    "Twenty thousand yuan."

    "You come to class as normal during this period, and I will transfer 20,000 yuan to you."

    Chen Feng was stunned for a moment, twenty thousand?

    This number was indeed beyond his expectation.

    He knew that Feng Xi's family was well off, but being able to pay 20,000 yuan directly for the selection of a class cadre really surprised him.

    If it were him a month ago, he might have agreed to the 20,000 yuan without even thinking about it.

    But now...

    Chen Feng thought about it in his mind.

    In half a month, there will be an on-campus selection for the provincial competition. His current physical fitness is 12.0, which is still 1 point short of the threshold for the mid-term physical conditioning.

    Just attending classes and training in school is definitely not enough.

    His only way was to repeatedly enter the Great Ruins in the past half month to collect spiritual materials and raise his physique to 13.

    If he stays in school honestly for half a month, attends classes during the day and trains at night, and follows the rules step by step, then his place in the provincial competition will have nothing to do with him.

    The prize money for the top ten in the provincial competition is up to RMB 100,000, as well as third-level assistant graduate student status and postgraduate opportunities.

    The sum of these things is far more than 20,000 yuan.

    "Sorry, monitor."

    Chen Feng shook his head,

    "I can't help you with this."

    Feng Xi's expression did not change, but he narrowed his eyes slightly.

    "Why?"

    Chen Feng looked calm and said: "I plan to participate in the provincial competition quota selection in half a month. During this time, I have to concentrate on my practice."

    After Feng Xi heard this, he was stunned for two seconds. The corners of his mouth moved, as if he wanted to say something but then swallowed it.
